title: Rory and the Starlight Meadow
verses:
As twilight was fading across the green hill,
Rory stepped very softly on patches of moss.
Every valley below them grew cozy and still,
While silver-lit shadows swung gently across.

Nia swooped through the leaves in the cool summer breeze,
While Ricky leaped over a rock in the night.
She perched on a branch of the sleepy tall trees,
And watched as the heavens were painted with light.

Tilly yawned near a hollow so quiet and deep,
And Benny stretched out on the warm, sandy ground.
The forest was slowly preparing for sleep,
Without any trouble or worry or sound.

Psittaco found a place on a warm leaf to rest,
Beside Rory's tail in the calm, quiet vale.
He curled up so snug in his grassy green nest,
As stars started shining so silvery pale.

The fireflies danced with a soft golden glow,
As gentle night breezes moved through the cool air.
The sound of the river ran steady and low,
And brought a sweet comfort to everyone there.

Now Rory relaxed and he closed his big eyes,
While dreams filled the canyon so peaceful and deep.
Beneath the dark blue of the velvet night skies,
The friends drifted off in a slumbering sleep.
